name: popsicle
headline: AI Automations for Marketing and Sales Workflows
short_description: Discover a comprehensive suite of AI automation blueprints on Make.com designed to streamline marketing, sales, and productivity tasks. These workflows enhance content generation, email campaigns, social media management, and lead handling, helping teams to work smarter.
author: Mr-Asante

sections.overview:
AI Automations is a curated collection of Make.com blueprints designed to automate marketing, sales, and productivity tasks. The skill includes pre-built workflows for AI content generation, email follow-ups, social media automation, lead management, and product photo processing. Each blueprint connects popular platforms like Gmail, Facebook, and Instagram with AI tools to reduce manual work and improve efficiency. Teams can import these JSON blueprints directly into Make.com, configure their API connections, and deploy automated workflows to handle repetitive tasks. This skill benefits marketing teams, sales representatives, and operations managers looking to scale their processes without additional hiring.
Automate email marketing campaigns
Generate social media content
Manage and nurture leads
Create automated reports for sales performance
